basis.quote: Given a local or remote event, a non-controller, non-witness, non-delegator validator MUST first verify the event's controller signatures, witness signatures (if witnessed), and delegator anchoring seal (if delegated) before it can accept that event into its copy of that event's KEL.
basis.text: Interoperability with keripy 1.x, not conformance: the reading the suite's KERI decision procedure (docs/design.md, KERI) gives a KERI 1.0 body with keripy 1.x's field set, where keri-v1.0.1 would grade the same reading SHOULD, inferred under the quoted sentence. description: A delegator's inception, then its interaction anchoring the delegated inception's seal, then the delegated inception with a seal source couple naming that interaction. A validator should accept all three. Built on keripy 1.x's wire: KERI 1.0 bodies with keripy 1.x's field sets and CESR 1.00 attachments, mirroring KERI-0030 (KS-37) in keri-v1.0.1.
title: keripy 1.x: delegated inception, anchor first
